summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature (uncommitted; tests not run per instructions). Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the formatting entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod, which passes one two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) for the title control. Tests added: test_set_window_title (console, output check skipped on legacy Windows), test_title (control), test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only renderer, mocked wrapper). CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200. Not verified by execution; renderer test only runs on Windows.
